decisions.rationale: In its FY2023 Form 10-K, Pfizer discusses managed care formularies and explicitly states that its branded products are increasingly being placed on higher tiers or in non-preferred status.

Apple’s Q2 FY2026 Form 10-Q explicitly states that, as of the filing, a U.S. court order barred Apple from charging any commission or fee on certain consumer purchases. It also says the Ninth Circuit directed the district court to modify the injunction, but does not say that the modification had already taken effect.

ExxonMobil’s Q3 FY2023 Form 10-Q explicitly states that Earnings (loss) excluding Identified Items is not meant to be viewed in isolation or used as a substitute for net income (loss) attributable to ExxonMobil under U.S. GAAP.
Costco’s 10-Q explicitly states that Costco Wholesale Corporation is named as an alleged joint employer in the Yesenia Murillo matter.

The Management’s Discussion and Analysis section of Exxon Mobil Corporation’s Q1 FY2026 Form 10-Q explicitly lists the ability to maintain near-term cost reductions as ongoing efficiencies without impairing competitive positioning among the factors that could affect forward-looking results.

Pfizer’s FY2023 Form 10-K explicitly states that its 2023 and 2022 legal charges primarily represented product liability and other legal expenses related to products Pfizer had discontinued or divested.

The filing explicitly states that the market multiplier approach used primarily pricing multiples from comparable publicly traded companies in industries similar to the reporting unit and included a control premium based on observed premiums paid in comparable change-in-control transactions involving financial institutions.

In the self-insurance section of Target's FY2023 10-K, management explicitly states that its liabilities could be significantly affected if future occurrences or loss developments differ from the assumptions used to estimate them.

Bank of America’s Q1 2025 Form 10-Q links the deterioration in commercial credit quality to an increase in criticized credit exposure, driven primarily by commercial real estate amid sustained high interest rates.
Pfizer’s FY2025 Form 10-K explicitly lists patent litigation settlements and judgments among the factors that “can have a material adverse effect on our revenues.”
Exxon Mobil’s Q3 2023 Form 10-Q explicitly lists every example in the claim as a political or regulatory factor that has affected or may affect its operations and earnings.

ExxonMobil’s Q3 2023 Form 10-Q explicitly states that management uses earnings excluding Identified Items to make underlying business results more comparable across periods by removing individually significant non-operational events.
Footnote (e) confirms that the reported amounts included dividend income from ViiV, but the excerpt does not identify the financial statement line item those amounts relate to.
Apple’s 10-Q states that as of March 30, 2024, two vendors accounted for 47% and 19% of total vendor non-trade receivables, respectively. Both shares exceeded the 10% threshold.

Bank of America’s 10-K says it gives more weight to directly observable valuation inputs and cites broker quotes in less active markets as an example of less reliable inputs because those quotes may be only indicative.

Apple’s FY2025 10-K explicitly states that gains and losses included in the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness are initially deferred in accumulated other comprehensive income or loss and reclassified into earnings when the hedged transaction affects earnings.

Bank of America’s Q1 2025 Form 10-Q explicitly states that commercial borrowers’ credit quality remained relatively stable since December 31, 2024, with office properties as the exception. The filing’s broader discussion of deterioration in the overall commercial portfolio does not negate that narrower assessment.

The 'Offsetting of Derivatives' section of Bank of America Corporation’s FY2023 Form 10-K explicitly states that the Corporation enters into ISDA master netting agreements or similar agreements with substantially all of its derivative counterparties.

The filing identifies uncertainty about whether near-term cost reductions can be sustained without harming ExxonMobil’s competitive position, but it does not indicate that the company considers this particular risk significant.
Costco’s FY2024 10-K explicitly identifies Wei and Henry as Real Water bodily injury actions and lists Costco Wholesale Corp. as a defendant in both case captions.

NVIDIA’s Q3 FY2026 Form 10-Q explicitly states that it estimated one AI research and deployment company contributed a meaningful amount to its revenue that quarter by purchasing cloud services from NVIDIA’s customers.
Item 15 of NVIDIA’s FY2025 Form 10-K explicitly states that the certifications furnished in Exhibits 32.1 and 32.2 will not be deemed filed for purposes of Section 18 of the Exchange Act.

The filing explicitly attributes the Level 3-to-Level 2 transfers of gross equity derivative receivables and payables in the quarter ended September 30, 2025, to increased observability and decreased significance of unobservable inputs.

The filing reports that Global Markets’ return on average allocated capital fell from 14% to 13% year over year and explicitly attributes the decline to higher allocated capital, partially offset by higher net income.

Apple’s FY2025 Form 10-K explicitly states that gains and losses on amounts included in the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness are initially deferred in accumulated other comprehensive income/(loss).

The excerpt supports the inference that assumed future salary growth had an immaterial effect on the reported obligations, but it does not state the 3.00% compensation increase assumption. It therefore does not independently support the full claim.

Note 7 explicitly states that, after its annual goodwill impairment test as of June 30, 2025, the Corporation concluded that none of its reporting units were at risk of impairment because each unit’s fair value substantially exceeded its carrying value.

ExxonMobil expects the savings to be sustainable relative to 2019 levels and says it may revise its estimates if prior reductions prove unsustainable. This acknowledges uncertainty but does not characterize the risk as significant or suggest that maintaining the savings could weaken its competitive position.

The filing states that the Corporation offsets derivative assets and liabilities with the same counterparty on the Consolidated Balance Sheet when a legally enforceable master netting agreement is in place. The policy covers ISDA agreements as well as similar agreements.
Pfizer’s Q1 2025 Form 10-Q explicitly identifies higher manufacturer discounts resulting from the IRA Medicare Part D redesign as the primary driver of the increase in Medicare rebates that quarter.

The filing states that legally enforceable master netting agreements give the Corporation the right to offset receivables and payables with the same counterparty in the event of that counterparty’s default. The claim omits that condition, and the separate discussion of balance-sheet netting does not establish a broader contractual right.
The filing excerpt explicitly states that dividend income from Pfizer’s investment in ViiV was recorded in Other (income)/deductions—net.
NVIDIA’s Q3 FY2026 Form 10-Q explicitly states that its revenue is concentrated among a limited number of direct, indirect, and cloud service purchasers and that this trend may continue.

JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s 10-Q explicitly reports that, for the three months ended September 30, 2025, significant transfers from level 3 into level 2 included $914 million in gross equity derivative receivables and $1.2 billion in gross equity derivative payables.

Costco’s Q3 FY2026 10-Q explicitly identifies membership fee increases as one of the main drivers of the 11% growth in membership fee revenue, alongside new member sign-ups and upgrades to Executive Membership.

ExxonMobil's Q3 2023 Form 10-Q explicitly states that the company believes earnings excluding Identified Items give investors greater transparency into business results and trends and show the business from management's perspective.

Apple’s 10-K explicitly states that for both cash flow and fair value hedges, amounts excluded from the hedge effectiveness assessment are recognized on a straight-line basis over the life of the hedge in the related Consolidated Statements of Operations line item.
Immediately after discussing the credit card interchange fee litigation settlements, the filing states, “Note 3 provides additional information.”

Costco’s Q3 FY2026 10-Q explicitly identifies upgrades to Executive Membership as one of the drivers of the 11% increase in quarterly membership fee revenue, alongside new member sign-ups and membership fee increases.

The excerpt shows that the top two vendors’ combined share fell from 71% to 66%, with the largest vendor still accounting for 47%. That supports the concentration interpretation, but the excerpt provides no dollar balances to establish that the absolute balance fell.
